accueil.welcomeText: Welcome to the best PVP runner game in France.
accueil.communityReady: An active community within the game
accueil.atmosphere: Our game reviewed by top journals
accueil.atmosphereDesc: An animated interface. Dynamic gradients, floating cards, and a guided path so every visit to the home page is an invitation to start a game.
accueil.instantGamesDesc: Instant games that change everything. Start a game in seconds and pick up right where you left off.
accueil.breathtakingVisionDesc: A breathtaking vision. Fluid animations and a clear grid to follow every move effortlessly.
accueil.extraordinaryChallengeDesc: An extraordinary challenge. Tension with bombs ready to explode at the slightest touch.
accueil.clearPathDesc: Science is made of so many things that seem obvious after being explained.
accueil.chooseYourSideDesc: Join your account and click play in a heartbeat.
accueil.observeTerrainDesc: We connect you with players from around the world in real-time.
accueil.alignAndWinDesc: Chain moves to dodge bombs and win the fight.
accueil.connectToSave: Log in to play and save your progress during your climb.
accueil.oneClickConnect: 3 clicks are enough to create an account and 10 clicks to delete your account after a sworn statement sent to support by registered mail.
accueil.alreadyConnected: You are already connected! Your progress is automatically saved.

lobby.tip1: Tip: bombs appear faster after stage 5.
lobby.tip2: Advice: chain jumps to avoid low bombs.
lobby.tip3: Remember to activate your cosmetics from your inventory.
lobby.tip4: Rare lootboxes offer better chances for epic items.
lobby.tip5: Gain XP to level up faster.
lobby.tip6: Tip: stay in motion to read trajectories.
lobby.tip7: Advice: jump timing is more important than speed.
lobby.tip8: Consider testing XP packs before a tournament.
lobby.tip9: Epic avatars are rarer in lootboxes.
lobby.tip10: Cosmetic effects do not change gameplay.
lobby.tip11: Check the stage to anticipate difficulty.
lobby.tip12: After a defeat, play again to stay warmed up.
lobby.tip13: Precious lootboxes offer the best epic rates.
lobby.tip14: Change your avatar to vary your style.
lobby.tip15: Low bombs are dodged with a short jump.
lobby.tip16: High bombs are dodged by staying on the ground.
lobby.tip18: Practice solo to master the rhythm.
lobby.tip19: Multiplayer mode gets more intense after stage 10.
lobby.tip20: A good streak increases your confidence, not your hitbox.
lobby.quote1: The dune coder knows that every bug is a grain of sand.
lobby.quote2: In the wind of the keyboard, logic carves its path.
lobby.quote3: The desert forgets nothing, and neither do the logs.
lobby.quote4: The algorithm is a caravan: move forward, adjust, move forward.
lobby.quote5: A clear function is worth a thousand lines of dust.
lobby.quote6: The dune coder tests before the storm.
lobby.quote7: Rarity is found in patience, not in chance.
lobby.quote8: Every refactor is a temporary oasis.
lobby.quote9: The silence of the desert feels like a successful build.
lobby.quote11: The dunes change, the architecture holds.
lobby.quote13: A good commit is a clear track in the sand.
lobby.quote14: The dune coder masters their dependencies.
lobby.quote16: In the dunes, every merge leaves an imprint.
lobby.quote17: The dune coder respects the main branch.
lobby.quote18: The wind shifts, production demands solid tests.
lobby.quote19: A clean diff is worth a storm-free journey.
lobby.quote20: The sand shifts, but API contracts remain.
lobby.quote21: Technical debt is a worm that grows in the shadows.
lobby.quote22: Unkept promises break like glass in the desert.
lobby.quote23: The CI pipeline is the caravan: follow it.
lobby.quote24: The dune coder logs before judging.
lobby.quote25: A quick rollback is an honorable retreat.
lobby.quote26: Production does not forget, much like the dunes.
lobby.quote27: Git is a chronology, not a trash can.
lobby.quote28: Review is a shelter from the heat of bugs.
lobby.quote29: A poorly managed cache is a deceptive mirage.
lobby.quote30: Clean code guides the caravan of features.
lobby.quote31: Secrets must remain buried in the sand.
lobby.quote32: Monitoring is the sentinel of cold nights.
lobby.quote33: The dune coder delivers small, but delivers often.
lobby.quote34: Simplicity survives the storms of production.
lobby.quote35: Refactoring is a journey, not a destination.
